stem: Skyline AR streams frames to 5G phones in one metro and needs single-digit millisecond latency close to carrier networks.

choices.text: Deploy compute in AWS Wavelength Zones.
Deploy the workload only in the parent Region
Deploy on AWS Outposts in the company office
Deploy in AWS Local Zones for all mobile carriers

rationale: Wavelength is designed for ultra-low-latency 5G-connected applications by placing compute at carrier edge locations. Running only in the parent Region usually adds network distance for mobile endpoints. Outposts targets on-premises facility constraints, not mobile carrier edge routing. Local Zones reduce latency near metros but are not the 5G carrier-edge model requested here.
